preconditions.description: The number of distinct score values m is between 1 and 31 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(set(a)) == m and all(0 <= x <= 30 for x in a)
preconditions.description: The input list a contains exactly m distinct integers, each between 0 and 30 inclusive.

postconditions.description: If no tournament exists with the required set of scores, the output is exactly the string '=('.

postconditions.expression: not no_solution and n == len(matrix) and all(len(row) == n for row in matrix)
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the first line is an integer n (number of vertices), followed by n lines each containing exactly n characters.

postconditions.expression: not no_solution and all(row[i] == '0' for i, row in enumerate(matrix))
postconditions.description: The main diagonal of the adjacency matrix contains only '0'.

postconditions.expression: not no_solution and all((matrix[i][j] == '1' and matrix[j][i] == '0') or (matrix[i][j] == '0' and matrix[j][i] == '1') for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n))
postconditions.description: For every pair of distinct vertices, exactly one directed edge exists between them (tournament property).

postconditions.expression: not no_solution and set(sum(row, '') for row in matrix) == set(str(x) for x in a)
postconditions.description: The set of out-degrees (scores) of the vertices in the constructed tournament is exactly the set S given in the input.
The number of vertices n is the minimum possible number of vertices for any tournament whose set of scores equals S.
